result.instructions: Tools for Project Insight, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are active right now, and who manages each one?"; "Show the open tasks in our website redesign project."; "Search for tasks with 'launch' in their name across active projects.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Project Insight data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run projectinsight_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run projectinsight_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run projectinsight_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. projectinsight_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: projectinsight_list_active_projects
tools.title: List active projects
tools.description: List every active project in the workspace. Good first call to see what is in progress. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/active.

tools.name: projectinsight_search_projects
tools.title: Search projects
tools.description: Search projects by text, customer, project number, or active/planning state. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/search.

searchText.description: Text to match in project fields.

modelProperties.description: Model properties to return, for example ["Name", "ProjectStatus"]. Omit for the defaults.

tools.name: projectinsight_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/list?ids={id}.

projectId.description: A Project Insight id (32-character hex, from another tool's output).

modelProperties.description: Model properties to return, for example ["Name", "ProjectStatus"]. Omit for the defaults.

tools.name: projectinsight_list_project_tasks
tools.title: List a project's tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one project, including the default task properties unless modelProperties is set. Project Insight API: GET /api/task/project/{projectId}.

projectId.description: A Project Insight id (32-character hex, from another tool's output).

modelProperties.description: Model properties to return, for example ["Name", "ProjectStatus"]. Omit for the defaults.

tools.name: projectinsight_search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by keyword, project, or whether they belong to active projects. Project Insight API: GET /api/task/search.

keywords.description: Text to match in task fields.

projectList.description: Comma-separated project ids to limit the search to.

modelProperties.description: Model properties to return, for example ["Name", "ProjectStatus"]. Omit for the defaults.

tools.name: projectinsight_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a new project in the given item container. This writes a new record each call and is not idempotent. Project Insight API: POST /api/project.

ItemContainer_Id.description: The id of the container (folder) the project is created in.

ItemNumber.description: Project number, if the workspace uses one.

ProjectMode.description: Project mode number from the workspace's model documentation.
